units.source_text: 源氏公子读了这诗，想见她那邸内长满了蔓草，没有人照拂她们，生涯必定困窘。

en.t: Prince Genji read the poem and imagined her residence overgrown with creeping weeds, with no one to care for them, and thought their life must surely be hard.

units.source_text: 又见她信中说：“梅雨连绵，处处土墙倒塌。”

en.t: He also saw that in her letter she had written, "The rainy season goes on without end, and earthen walls have collapsed everywhere."

units.source_text: 便命令京中家臣，派附近领地内的人夫前往修筑。

en.t: He therefore ordered his retainers in the capital to send laborers from a nearby estate to go and repair them.
